title: Train Short, Test Long: Attention with Linear Biases
authors: O. Press, N. Smith, M. Lewis
before: Models trained at one context length degraded sharply when run on longer inputs.
problem: Position embeddings do not generalise past the lengths they were trained on.
breakthrough: Drop position embeddings and instead subtract a penalty from attention scores proportional to distance.
why: It framed length extrapolation as a goal in itself and offered the main alternative to RoPE.
next: Used in BLOOM; RoPE with interpolation eventually won more adopters.
inherits: Length extrapolation as an explicit design criterion.
